extracted.name: No Bake Peanut Butter Oat Bars
extracted.description: These bars are super simple to make and are a terrific snack or a healthier sweet treat. You can use whatever you'd like for the mix-ins (dried cranberries, raisins, shredded coconut, chocolate chips, etc.). Recipe adapted from: cleananddelicious.com
ingredient_lines: 1/2 cup mix-ins of choice: we like walnuts & pumpkin seeds
instruction_lines: Line a 8x8" pan with parchment paper and set it aside. Mix all the ingredients together in a large bowl. Turn out the mixture into the prepared pan and flatten it down evenly. Pop it in the fridge to firm up for a couple of hours, then cut them into square bars.
That's it! Store them covered in the fridge for 5-7 days or freeze them if you want them to last even longer.
